subject: Air freight quote to DXB
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! I need to send the same shipment again, this time to DXB instead of GRU.

The previous request was “Fastest air freight option: HAM to GRU”, sent on 2026-11-22 at 07:37 UTC, for GRU. The cargo and pickup details are unchanged, so you already have them from that request.

It’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest option to DXB?

Thanks!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

subject: Re: Rate request HAM-DXB, 1353 kg
body:
Hello,

thank you for your request. We do not serve this lane/zone: HAM-DXB.
We fly CGN-DFW, CGN-MIA, CGN-SGN, DUS-BOM, FRA-LOS, FRA-NRT, FRA-PEK, HAM-RUH, HAM-YYZ, MUC-BOG, MUC-DXB, MUC-YYZ, STR-PVG.

Best regards
Lumen Air Cargo
lumen-air-cargo@hackloop.mail
